card.name: Small words in royal and constitutional history
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, of, the, be, to) in history and government text about kings, thrones, regalia, coronations and constitutions. It fires where the next word is expected to be a place, title or institution.

modes.label: Prepositions in monarchy history
modes.description: A preposition or article inside text about thrones, kings or regalia, just before a place or title.
modes.example: Copies of the Imperial Regalia, the originals of which are<< in>> Vienna, are exhibited in the town hall

modes.label: Constitutional wording
modes.description: A linking word in text about constitutional rules and procedures.

modes.label: Dates after rulers
modes.description: A preposition after a ruler's name, before a year.
modes.example: With the death of Constantine I<< in>> 337, Athanasius
